for_systems_without_an_active_keyring_ke: For systems without an active keyring. Keys and tokens stay only in this process's memory, without being saved to disk. Sign in again after fully exiting PeliGames. Closing a tab or the chat window does not end the session. Existing keyring credentials stay there; this mode neither imports nor deletes them.
keeps_you_signed_in_between_launches_req: Keeps you signed in between launches. Requires an available, unlocked compatible keyring on any Linux desktop.
disconnect_before_changing_modes_existin: Disconnect before changing modes. Existing keyring credentials are not migrated into temporary sessions.
